commits.messageBody:
Hearings of a proceeding (V400): schedule, reschedule, record held,
adjourned (creates the next hearing) or cancelled, with 422 rules
HEARING_BEFORE_FILING, HEARING_NOT_SCHEDULED, HEARING_NOT_YET_HELD,
ADJOURNMENT_NOT_LATER and CASE_ARCHIVED, one hearing per proceeding
and day (409), row locks and timeline events. Hearing calendar
GET /api/v1/hearings and HearingReportQueries for Phase 6.

Frontend: /hearings calendar (flipped to ready), CaseOperations with
the case hearings, mounted on the case details page after QAD-027.
Acceptance criteria for LD-024..LD-029 in PHASE-5-ACCEPTANCE.md.

commits.messageBody:
Integration review of PR #33: hearing.case_id repeats proceeding.case_id
and the database did not enforce that they match. V401 adds the trigger
hearing_case_matches_proceeding (insert and update of case_id or
proceeding_id); no composite key, so Workstream C's table is untouched.
The API already took the case from the proceeding; a test now pins that
a caseId in the body is ignored. Evidence LD-024-11..13 (426/426).

commits.messageBody:
Rescheduling and adjourning keep the proceeding's case even when the
body names another case or proceeding; the next hearing created by an
adjournment is on the same case (checked against proceeding.case_id).
Regression after merging develop bdd9d42: backend 429/429, frontend
375/375, tools 97/97, deploy 155/155 (LD-024-14..17).
